V. 44. The three following Parables are propoſed not to the Mul
•••, but peculiarly to the Apoſtles: The two former of them re
••• thoſe who receive the Goſpel; the third, both to thoſe who receive and thoſe who preach it. The kingdom of heaven is like treaſure hid in a field—The Kingdom of GOD within us, is a Treaſure indeed, but a Treaſure hid from the World, and from the moſt wiſe and prudent in it. He that finds this Treaſure (perhaps when he thought it far from him) hides it deep in his Heare, and gives up all other Happineſs for it.
